title: Biscuit Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: Beyond the kitchen, you'll find a spacious living room adorned with a gas log fireplace, a 55-inch curved screen Smart TV, a plush slipcovered sofa, two oversized upholstered chairs, three poufs, and a cushioned window seat. The main floor also features a king master bedroom with a private bathroom that includes both indoor and outdoor showers. An additional bedroom on this level offers two single beds and a private half bath. Conveniently adjacent to the living room is a full bath that opens up to a private outdoor shower. The main floor also includes a fully furnished laundry room with a soaking sink and a built-in ironing station. This home on Forest Street is a beloved gem, boasting original timber shiplap detailing, subway tile accents, and luxurious fixtures and accessories. The main level features a fully renovated kitchen equipped with a French door fridge and freezer, gas cooktop, 24" microwave, and a generous five cu ft capacity 30" wall oven, perfect for preparing a mouthwatering Thanksgiving feast for twelve. Gather around the expansive stone-topped island with bar stools for easy conversation, or enjoy a delightful meal at the dining room's grand trestle table, beneath the soaring 22-foot ceilings, comfortably seating eight to ten adults.
